title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
subtitle: Patient Mentor
text: Action [Exhaust]: Heal 1 damage from a unit.
deployBox:
Sentinel (Units in this arena can’t attack your non-Sentinel units or your base.)
On Attack: Heal 1 damage from a unit. If you do, deal 1 damage to a different unit.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: "A different unit" in Obi-Wan's unit side ability refers to a unit other than the one healed. Obi-Wan's unit side ability may be used to deal 1 damage to Obi-Wan.
